verdict: VAT invoice totals blank since 2.1.0 due to an unreviewed rounding change; ORB-101 closure timing remains to be confirmed and no delivery date for the fix is present in the verified findings.

sentences.text: VAT invoice exports began showing blank totals after the 2.1.0 upgrade, which blocked your finance team's reconciliation.
The cause was the BILLING-V2 refactor, which moved VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, dropping fractional cents and blanking the export totals.
